title: Gold Account: No-transfer-fee advantage
summary: This document describes the Gold Account “No-transfer-fee advantage,” stating that transfer fees are Yes (reducing the cost of moving funds) and that instant transfers are Yes for quick cash repositioning. It also highlights use cases like rebalancing between eligible accounts and covering time-sensitive payments, with a tip to confirm details due to possible third-party charges.
